answer: Treat new keys as tourists until they change terrain. Before a key can attest or withdraw, it must finish one paid job in a tight operational canyon such as parcel routing, then a later job in another specialty, each signed by counterparties that share no treasury. A polished fable of competence that works in one niche usually fails the second hop. Only after both receipts land does a small oasis of spendable credit open, dripping out through a dispute window. Matching funding graphs or clocks drain the oasis and slash the escrow, so extra aliases cost real, diverse labor.
